Package com.signalwire.sdk.swml

Class Service

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.swml.Service
Direct Known Subclasses:
AgentBase
public class Service extends Object
Base SWML service with an embedded HTTP server, basic auth, security headers, and explicit methods for all 38 schema-driven verbs.

Uses JDK built-in com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer with virtual threads.

    • REQUEST_BODY_ATTR

      public static final String REQUEST_BODY_ATTR
      HttpExchange attribute key under which the raw POST body is stashed by serve() when reading it up-front for signature validation. Subclasses (notably AgentBase) check this attribute in renderMainSwml so they can re-use the cached body without re-reading the (already-consumed) request stream.

    • getRegisteredTools

      public Map<String,ToolDefinition> getRegisteredTools()
      Public, read-only view of the registered SWAIG tool registry. Returned in insertion order; the map and its definitions are unmodifiable. Used by introspection callers (CLI --list-tools file-loader path, tests, audit tooling) that need name + description + parameters without going through /swaig HTTP.

    • getRegisteredSwaigFunctions

      public List<Map<String,Object>> getRegisteredSwaigFunctions()
      Read-only view of the raw SWAIG function entries registered via registerSwaigFunction(java.util.Map). These are typically DataMap or schema-only tools that don't have a Java ToolHandler. Each entry is a defensive copy of the original map; the outer list is unmodifiable.

    • swaigPreDispatch

      protected Object[] swaigPreDispatch(Map<String,Object> requestData, String funcName)
      Extension point: invoked between argument parsing and function dispatch. Returns a 2-element array: [target Service, shortCircuit Map]. If shortCircuit is non-null, it's returned as the SWAIG response without calling onFunctionCall. AgentBase may override to add session-token validation or ephemeral dynamic-config copies.

    • renderMainSwml

      protected Map<String,Object> renderMainSwml(HttpExchange exchange)
      Extension point: render the SWML document for the main path or for GET /swaig. Default returns the currently-built Document. AgentBase overrides to emit prompt + AI verb at request time.

    • registerAdditionalRoutes

      protected void registerAdditionalRoutes(HttpServer server)
      Extension point: register additional HTTP routes after Service mounts /health, /ready, /swaig and the main route. AgentBase uses this to add /post_prompt and /mcp.

    • onRequest

      public Map<String,Object> onRequest(Map<String,Object> requestData, String callbackPath)
      Customization hook called when SWML is requested. Default delegates to onSwmlRequest(java.util.Map, String) and returns its result. Subclasses typically override onSwmlRequest rather than this method.

      Returning null uses the default rendered SWML; returning a non-null map merges the entries as modifications.

      Python parity: WebMixin.on_request(request_data, callback_path). The Python third request parameter is FastAPI-specific and intentionally not mirrored.

      Parameters:
      requestData - parsed request body, or null
      callbackPath - optional callback sub-path, or null
      Returns:
      modifications map, or null for default rendering

    • onSwmlRequest

      public Map<String,Object> onSwmlRequest(Map<String,Object> requestData, String callbackPath)
      Customization point for subclasses to modify SWML based on request data. The default implementation returns null (no modification). Subclasses override to inspect the body or callback path and return a map of SWML overrides.

      Python parity: WebMixin.on_swml_request(request_data, callback_path). The Python third request parameter is FastAPI-specific and intentionally not mirrored.

      Parameters:
      requestData - parsed request body, or null
      callbackPath - optional callback sub-path, or null
      Returns:
      modifications map, or null

    • validateSignedWebhook

      protected boolean validateSignedWebhook(HttpExchange exchange, String rawBody)
      Extension hook invoked between raw-body capture and JSON parsing on signed POST routes (/, /swaig, /post_prompt). Subclasses (AgentBase) override to enforce SignalWire webhook signature validation when a signing key is configured. Default returns true (no validation).

      Returning false signals "signature invalid"; the caller sends 403 Forbidden and stops dispatch. Per porting-sdk/webhooks.md the response body must NOT disclose which branch failed.

      Parameters:
      exchange - the HTTP exchange.
      rawBody - the raw UTF-8 body string already read from the exchange. Pass through to WebhookValidator.
      Returns:
      true when validation passes (or is disabled); false to short-circuit with a 403.
